title: = to Getting Underwear for Christmas
text: Tried twice & each time DARK lipstick I won’t use... 1st box mainly tiny travel moisturizers that are really too small (more like free samples you’d get at the mall) will use them on a overnight getaway.  I’ll try it one more month just cause I like surprises... the first one = to underwear at Christmas. 2nd was like getting a new crockpot. Wish I could request shades for lipstick since in both boxes it was the full size product and it’s gone in the junk draw.
label: negative
